stratagems.name: Excess of Sensation
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army destroys one or more enemy models.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains 1 Depravity point. If your unit has 3 or more Depravity points, it gains the Fights First ability until the end of the battle round.

stratagems.name: Slaanesh's Gift
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in your unit and each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Dirge Caster
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit from your army that is within 12" of a charging enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch while within 6" of your unit.
